title: How I built and shipped an Idle RPG as a solo dev using an AI pipeline — Idle Rift RPG post-mortem & lessons learned
author: YakFederal3939
selftext:
Hey everyone,

​I just released [Idle Rift RPG](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kotmstudios.idleriftrpg) on Android, and I wanted to share the AI-assisted pipeline that made shipping this project possible alongside my day job.

​Building an idle RPG as a solo developer at KOTM Studios comes with obvious bottlenecks around asset throughput, itemization lore, and progression math. Here is how I structured the workflow:

​**Simulating progression curves**: Modeled reward scaling, idle math, and token economy curves with LLM simulations before hardcoding progression tiers.

​**Iterating visual assets**: Generated character concepts and rift environments, followed by manual UI integration and sprite optimization.

​**Structuring itemization**: Drafted gear tiers, affix names, and flavor text through prompt templates to ensure diverse loot tables.

​If you're building in the idle/RPG space with generative tools, I'd love to hear how you're handling progression balance and pipeline automation.

​You can try it out on [Google Play](https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.kotmstudios.idleriftrpg). Any feedback on the first 10 minutes of onboarding or the visual cohesion is greatly appreciated!
